reels.series: Read This Before Your Next Shift

props.body: Call me as soon as you see this.

frames.text: Your boss texts at 9:47 PM. *Your stomach drops.*
That's not overreacting. That's what *walking on eggshells* does to you.

props.text: I can take this on if the report moves to Monday.

frames.text: You finished early. Your reward? *More work.*
Being dependable should never mean being *endlessly available.*
Next time, don't just take it. *Trade it.*
Follow so this finds you again *when you need it.*
frames.sub: Send this to the coworker who always says yes.

slides.text: Your memory will fade. *Your notes won't.*
slides.sub: How to document a difficult boss, the right way.

slides.text: Another comment in front of everyone. You tell yourself *you'll remember it.*
One incident is easy to dismiss. *A dated pattern* is much harder to ignore.
Vague notes written weeks later: *"He's always rude to me."*
Same day, write down: *date, time, place, exact words,* who was there.
Oct 19, 9:40 a.m. Team call. Manager said: "This is useless." Present: Sam, Priya.
Follow *@unspokenatwork1* so this finds you again when you need it.
slides.sub: And save it. Your future self will thank you.
